entry.title: Cost-Bounded Transaction Filtering Language
entry.summary:
The screenshot from satd's TUI highlights the display of quarantine status within the interface. The visual representation offers users immediate feedback regarding the files or items that have been quarantined, ensuring transparency and clarity in threat management operations. Such a feature is essential for users who need to monitor and manage potential security risks efficiently.
By integrating quarantine status directly into the TUI, satd simplifies the process of tracking and handling suspicious elements. This approach reduces reliance on external logs or reports, and instead centralizes critical information, making it easily accessible during routine checks or incident response scenarios. As a result, users can make informed decisions quickly, enhancing overall system security and workflow efficiency.
